page.overview:
What is Sodatha?

Sodatha, also known as the Slithering God and the Hidden One, is a possible Great Old One by Marvel Comics, (: Official Handbook of the Marvel Universe A-Z #3) and a spawn of the Outer God Yog-Sothoth. (: The Appendix to the Handbook of the Marvel Universe)

Yog-Sothoth is known by the same name. (: "Valley Beyond the Stars")

Sodatha was a great tentacled subterranean monster, which lived within the walled city of Hanghrara in the kingdom of Zamora during the Hyborian Age. The Cult of Sodatha worshiped it as an elder god. It was a creature that possessed great strength, enough to destroy a city and it was capable of borrowing deep and fast. Guarding the tunnels to Sodatha were its spawn, miniature versions of itself. Both Sodatha and its spawn had a maw full of teeth, and many tentacles and eyes. Conan would encounter it in his adventures and during his fighting with its priests, boiling oil ended up on the abomination. Enraged with pain it burst from the ground into the city, toppling buildings and causing the populace to panic. Its inhabitants left the destroyed city in a mass exodus. (: "The Slithering God")
